title: Hallways
description:
#p A minimal traditional roguelike, heavily inspired by House of Leaves. Made in 48 hours for Mini Jam 39, I saved time by omitting a combat system. This turned the game into a long chase scene, where you need to to unlock the door and escape before the minotaur catches you.
#p The other standout feature is the level generation. Instead of using the usual hallway-and-room approach, I tried to approach the surreal maze of House of Leaves by creating a series of repeated patterns.
#p In it's current version the game keeps generating bigger, more difficult levels forever. Future updates may include an ending and win state, but for now I like the game as it is.
snippet: A minimal traditional roguelike, heavily inspired by House of Leaves.
